review_candidates.title: Tier 1 Analyst
review_candidates.description: About Torus Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000-square-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. We are the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power. We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end-to-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last. Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. About The Role We are seeking a detail-oriented and mission-driven Tier 1 Analyst to join our Torus Overwatch Command team. This role is critical in safeguarding the performance and safety of our energy assets across the country. The Tier 1 Analyst will serve as the first line of defense for system anomalies, emergency events, and performance deviations. You’ll be working as a real-time operator, dispatcher, and triage coordinator for renewable energy and battery storage systems in residential, utility and C&I environments. Who You Are You’ll be a good fit if you have solid technical depth and a strong customer mindset. You proactively identify and diagnose issues, not just respond to alerts, and communicate them clearly. You’re detail-oriented, organized, and able to work through complex issues and make decisions without perfect information. This role supports between field service and real-time operations. You’re responsible for analyzing systems and escalating information through the appropriate channels. Quality and safety matter in how you work. You’re comfortable in a fast-moving environment and willing to help build the way we operate as we grow. Responsibilities Real-Time Monitoring: Continuously monitor asset performance, alarms, and telemetry for solar, battery, and hybrid energy systems using SCADA and fleet management platforms. Incident Detection & Response: Identify safety and performance anomalies, classify events by severity, and initiate response procedures including dispatch or escalation. Coordination & Dispatch: Act as central communicator for field operations, coordinating technician dispatch, scheduling interventions, and updating stakeholders on incident status. First-Level Troubleshooting: Execute predefined triage procedures for common faults, perform remote resets or diagnostics, and escalate issues with supporting context when necessary. Performance Alerts: Monitor KPIs such as inverter availability, charge/discharge rates, temperature thresholds, and SOC trends; flag underperformance or system drift. Documentation: Maintain accurate logs of alarms, incidents, communications, and shift turnovers for auditability and continuous improvement. Communication Hub: Interface with internal teams (engineering, field service, customer support) to ensure aligned responses and timely resolution. Emergency Protocols: Activate emergency response playbooks in the event of fire risk, grid safety concerns, or battery thermal events—ensuring safety, compliance, and rapid escalation. Required Experience 2+ years of experience in operations/monitoring roles, NOC/SOC environments, or utility/dispatch roles (O&M, SCADA, EMS, etc.) Strong technical aptitude; comfortable with interpreting real-time data, alarms, and fault codes Calm under pressure, highly organized, and able to follow detailed procedures in live scenarios Excellent written and verbal communication; clear, concise reporting and professional coordination Must be able to work on a rotating schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays Preferred Experience Degree or certification in electrical technology, energy systems, engineering, or a related field Experience with SCADA, energy monitoring platforms (e.g., AlsoEnergy, Fluence, Power Factors), or dispatch tools is a plus Familiarity with renewable energy systems (PV, BESS, FESS), microgrid operations, or critical infrastructure monitoring Experience in emergency response, 911 dispatch, or field coordination roles Understanding of NERC, NFPA, or OSHA safety principles related to electrical or energy infrastructure Additional Details Background Check All candidates are subject to a background check. Location + Travel The role is hybrid remote with regular onsite work at our GigaOne warehouse in Salt Lake City (air-conditioned). May require occasional onsite work at our South Salt Lake HQ Ware house and/or Springville R&D warehouse (air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned). Schedule Full-Time, Salaried (Requires rotational on-call work including nights and weekends.) Compensation $58,000-75,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) Work Authorization Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. Physical Requirements Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse. When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet. When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. Our Perks & Benefits Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Financial Employee Rewards Package including equity 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Torus paid life and AD&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage Voluntary short- and long-term disability insurance Health & Wellness Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more. Time Off Unlimited discretionary PTO or 10 days annual PTO 10 paid company holidays Waiting period-free 100% paid parental leave Culture & Community Regular company-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. Team members receive Torus branded gear Peer Recognition Program Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel. Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Torus participates in E-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Marfy Touch is a furniture company focused on creating custom-made modern pieces tailored to individual preferences. The team works closely with customers to understand their style, functional needs, and space requirements. Marfy Touch values craftsmanship, innovation, and a personalized experience throughout the design and production process. The company continues to grow by combining contemporary design with high-quality materials and attention to detail, driven forward by both exceptional in-house creation and strategic external collaborations. Role Description The Technical and Partnership Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo. This role is responsible for translating client requirements and design concepts into technical specifications, drawings, and practical solutions for custom modern furniture. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with clients and production teams, reviewing technical feasibility, overseeing the workshop, and ensuring quality standards are met during manufacturing. The engineer will also identify, develop, and maintain partnerships strategies with business partners to introduce service offerings and possible opportunities. Qualifications ·       Strong technical skills in engineering or furniture design, including the ability to create and interpret technical drawings and specifications. ·       0-2 years of experience working with manufacturing or production environments, preferably in furniture, interior design, or related industries. ·       Partnership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with suppliers, contractors, and business partners. ·       Project coordination abilities, including planning, time management, and follow-through on multiple assignments. ·       Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams and clients. ·       Problem-solving and analytical skills for assessing technical feasibility, resolving production issues, and improving deals. ·       Bachelor’s degree in Applied Arts or Architecture / Architectural Engineering or a related field is preferred. ·       Proficiency with relevant design or CAD tools and Office suite, in addition to basic familiarity with materials, fabrication methods, and quality standards. ·       Ability to work on-site and to conduct filed visits to sites and possible parners in Cairo and adapt to a dynamic, customer-focused environment.

review_candidates.title: Service Desk /Helpdesk Associate - Remote
review_candidates.description: Req ID: 393695 NTT DATA Services strives to hire exceptional, innovative, and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. Hospital Clinical Service Desk Analyst – 24/7 Support Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire Company: NTT DATA Services Schedule: 24x7x365 Support Environment – Shift Flexibility Required If you have applied previously to this or a similar position with NTT DATA and have not been contacted, we encourage you to reapply. Position Overview NTT DATA Services is seeking experienced Hospital Clinical Service Desk Analysts to join our healthcare technology support team. In this role, you will serve as a critical point of contact for healthcare professionals, providing application support for clinical systems used in hospitals and healthcare organizations. You will work in a 24x7x365 service desk environment , assisting clinicians and healthcare customers with application issues, access requests, workflow questions, and technical incidents. The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with excellent communication, customer service, and problem-solving abilities. This is an excellent opportunity for a service desk professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to apply their technical expertise within the healthcare technology industry. Responsibilities: Provide Level 1/Level 2 service desk support to healthcare customers and clinical users. Handle inbound calls and support requests in a high-volume, customer-focused call center environment. Troubleshoot issues involving clinical applications and systems, including Epic, Cerner, McKesson, Meditech, and other healthcare applications. Assist users with: Application errors and functionality issues Clinical workflow questions User access and authentication issues Technical troubleshooting and incident resolution Accurately document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions in the service management system. Resolve incidents within established service levels or appropriately escalate issues to specialized support teams. Take ownership of incidents through resolution while maintaining a strong customer-service focus. Communicate clearly and professionally with clinicians, healthcare staff, technical teams, and internal stakeholders. Work effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where priorities may change quickly. Follow established processes, procedures, security requirements, and service-level expectations. Participate in training and ongoing learning to maintain knowledge of supported applications and technologies. Schedule & Work Environment Because our healthcare customers rely on these systems around the clock, 24x7x365 support coverage is required . Candidates must be comfortable working a flexible schedule that may include: Day, evening, or overnight shifts Weekends Holidays Overtime, when required by business needs Schedule changes based on client requirements, business needs, or training Important: Account-specific training may be scheduled during daytime hours regardless of your eventual assigned shift. Additional requirements include: Ability to remain at a designated workstation and actively participate in the phone queue for 8–10 hour shifts, with scheduled breaks. Ability to read and work from computer screens throughout the shift. For remote work, a quiet, private workspace and high-speed wired internet connection are required. A working mobile phone is required for manager communication and two-factor authentication (2FA). Ability to travel up to 10%, when required. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. when equipment setup or support activities require it. Required Qualifications 4+ years of service desk, help desk, technical support, or remote support experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. At least 1 year of hands-on technical troubleshooting experience. High school diploma or equivalent. Strong verbal and written English communication skills. Excellent listening and problem-solving abilities. Strong customer-service orientation and the ability to work effectively with clinicians and healthcare professionals. Comfortable working in a 24x7x365 support environment with rotating or non-traditional shifts. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in a call center or high-volume service desk environment. Experience supporting healthcare, hospital, clinical, or medical applications. Exposure to clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, McKesson, or Meditech. IT service management or ITIL experience/certification. Experience working with incident management and ticketing systems. Strong typing and computer navigation skills. Demonstrated ability to remain calm, patient, and solution-oriented during challenging customer interactions. Previous experience supporting mission-critical applications in a 24x7 environment. Why Join NTT DATA Services? NTT DATA Services is a recognized leader in healthcare technology, helping healthcare organizations improve patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and the delivery of care through technology. Our healthcare solutions span patient engagement, predictive analytics, cloud hosting, integration and interoperability, clinical and claims applications, revenue cycle management, policy administration, managed infrastructure, and business process services . By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to support technology that is essential to healthcare organizations and the clinicians who depend on it every day. Employment & Benefits This position is available only as a direct employment opportunity with NTT DATA, Inc. or one of its subsidiaries . Temporary, contract, Corp-to-Corp (C2C), or equivalent contractor arrangements will not be considered. NTT DATA offers a comprehensive benefits package beginning on your first day of employment , along with the opportunity to build your career with a global technology and healthcare services organization. Pay Transparency Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $38,000 - $56,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits. About NTT DATA NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D. Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us . This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here . If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . For Pay Transparency information, please click here .

Opportunity to build a solid career foundation in international intellectual property law and corporate client relations.
